key_idea: Only n <= 4000 lines, so each query can simply loop over all earlier waves; coordinates up to 1e9 never need to be materialised.
sketch: Store every wave (p, l, a). For a query at position x, sum over waves with p <= x < p+l the value a if (x-p) mod 4 == 0, -a if it is 2, and 0 otherwise. O(n^2) = 16e6 operations worst case. Use 64-bit sums (up to 4000 * 1e9). The 'obvious' heavy solution (four difference arrays with coordinate compression) is unnecessary.
